title: Lorie Barnes visited by blue dwarfs while pregnant
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Lorie Barnes visited by blue dwarfs while pregnant, about 1954 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We're interested in the girl child you're carrying.

plain: A writer, Whitley Strieber, passes on the story of a woman named Lorie Barnes, who he says was visited by small blue beings in 1954 while she was pregnant. According to the story, they told her, "We're interested in the girl child you're carrying." If true, it would suggest these beings take a special interest in certain people even before they are born.
